skill.summary: Professional Juniper Network Security Configuration Generator for enterprise-grade network hardening.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Juniper OS Security Hardening Tool.

- Provides an API to generate production-ready Juniper network hardening configurations based on user-specified options.
- Supports SSH, firewall, authentication, syslog, and SNMP hardening features aligned with best practices.
- Includes endpoints for configuration generation, health checks, and retrieving available hardening options.
- Outputs validated, ready-to-deploy Juniper OS configuration files.
- Designed for network security professionals seeking streamlined, automated hardening for Juniper devices.
- Offers multiple pricing tiers, including a free plan.
